title: Capture a twelve-cell pack's shared spring preload with a cross-key
instruction: Seat the pressure plate on the twelve loaded cells, compress their terminal springs, insert the retaining cross-key, and release both hands with all twelve contacts held stable.
context: Battery-pack closure transfers distributed terminal contact forces from an assembly press to a permanent retaining key. Releasing preload before the key is seated can lose multiple electrical contacts.
setup:
Bimanual YAM station, two parallel grippers; table top z=0.7475 m. Coordinates are metres, x forward/y left/z up; masses kg; quaternions XYZW. Fixed seed0, no object jitter. Authored origins below settle under gravity during reset. All27 rigid bodies are:
Holder: fixed plastic fixture,0.7kg, collision envelope0.310x0.162x0.0845, origin(0.225,0,0.7475), identity orientation. Its compound geometry includes cell sleeves, retaining channels and the empty loading supports.
Twelve plastic contact-shoe proxies contact_0..11: each0.002kg,0.012x0.012x0.002. For i=0..11, x=0.100+0.050*(i mod6); y=-0.028 for i<6, otherwise+0.028; z=0.7555. Each moves vertically on its own passive500N/m spring; all start at zero joint displacement.
Twelve inert AA-cell surrogates cell_0..11: each0.024kg,14.5mm-diameter50.5mm cylinder plus a1.5mm positive terminal; total collision height51.8mm. They occupy the same x/y grid as their contact shoes. Even indices start at z=0.78225 with quaternion(0,0,0,1); odd indices at z=0.78355 with quaternion(1,0,0,0), reversing the positive end. Cells begin loaded. Inert metal dummy cells are the intended physical proxies; electrochemistry is omitted.
Loose plastic pressure plate retaining_plate:0.18kg, compound grid/handle envelope0.308x0.114x0.0487, origin(0.285,0.230,0.7515), identity orientation.
Loose cross-key capture_key:0.08kg,0.014x0.156x0.014, origin(0.385,-0.240,0.7547), identity orientation. An aluminium bar is the intended inert physical proxy.
Rigid surrogate materials and assigned masses/contact properties are estimates, not calibrated hardware data. All simulated contacts use static/dynamic friction0.65/0.5 and zero restitution. SETUP.md gives the complete body inventory; scene.json and original USD assets specify every primitive, local offset, spring, joint limit and fixed transform. The setup screenshot shows the settled starting layout. Physical judging-only optical access and scales: MEASUREMENT.md; omitted from native rendering.
scoring: 0.04 per seated cell contact under the aligned plate, totaling 0.48. Each cell is within 1 mm of its target and 0.105 rad of its polarity axis, with 0.35–1.8 mm spring compression. Add 0.52 for the seated cross-key with all twelve contacts. Plate and key position limits are 0.8 mm and 1 mm, with 0.105 rad angular limits. Full score requires 1 second of stability and 20 mm robot clearance. Dropped parts, displaced fixtures and prohibited overlap invalidate the trial. Cell stability uses20Hz observed longitudinal-axis tilt rate at most0.2rad/s and centre speed at most0.01m/s; axial cell spin is geometrically equivalent. Other bodies use native angular velocity. In a physical build, read each terminal noninvasively through the solid optical windows: compression c_i=8.000mm minus contact-disc witness height h_i; the same0.35–1.80mm range is h_i=6.20–7.65mm. See MEASUREMENT.md for calibration, photos and all12 access locations.
run_limit: 3600 control actions at 20 Hz (180 simulated seconds maximum)
reset_notes: Native reset restores the authored layout and zero joint coordinates, settles through the official adapter, clears scorer history, and records a new episode. Native probes compare two reset repetitions within 3 mm. Seed 0; object_jitter=0.
fidelity: Rigid cells and passive terminal shoes model polarity, seating and spring compression. A free pressure plate compresses the contacts and a free cross-key captures its load through real channels. Enlarged geometry aids parallel-jaw handling. Electrochemistry, corrosion and electrical tests are omitted. Native physics runs at480Hz with20Hz robot actions. Physical judging uses flush solid transparent patches in the outer and cell-guide walls, contact-disc midheight witness lines and coplanar scales (MEASUREMENT.md). These judging-only optical details are omitted from the native opaque-wall rendering; wall geometry/contact surfaces, spring motion and scoring thresholds are unchanged. Physical photographic validation is not claimed. Physical contact wells provide full2mm travel; native parent/disc collision filtering approximates this internal clearance (MEASUREMENT.md).
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (3,600 actions); demo: 1.0 (1,677 actions); independent expert repeat: 1.0 (1,677 actions).
